name: video-lab
description: Local video studio: storyboards become a narrated animatic before any paid render, recordings are cut by their transcript into 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 with captions, and app walkthroughs are recorded with narration.
author: zorai

whisper_model.label: Whisper model
whisper_model.description: faster-whisper size for word timings and captions: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3

device.label: Whisper device
device.description: auto uses the GPU when it can and falls back to the CPU; or set cuda or cpu

scene_threshold.label: Scene change sensitivity
scene_threshold.description: How different two frames must be to count as a new scene (0.1 finds many, 0.5 only hard cuts)

video_cost_per_second.label: Video price per second (USD)
video_cost_per_second.description: Your video provider's price per generated second, used for the estimate shown before a paid render. Leave empty if you do not know it.

run.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py check

uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py search

check.description: Show whether ffmpeg, the hardware encoder, Whisper, narration voices, Chrome and the cloud image and video providers are ready

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py check --format markdown

animatic.description: Build a narrated animatic from a project's storyboard (keyframes, voice, captions). Add --project <name> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py animatic

estimate.description: Show what rendering a storyboard's video shots will cost. Add --project <name>

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py estimate

render.description: Render a storyboard's approved shots with the cloud video provider. Costs money: only after the user approved the estimate. Add --project <name> --approve true --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py render

index.description: Index a video: scene changes, keyframes and a word-timed transcript. Add --path <file> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py index

search.description: Search an indexed video's transcript. Add --path <file> --query "<words>"

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py search

cut.description: Render a project's edit: tighten pauses and filler words, crop to each format and burn in captions. Add --project <name> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py cut

demo.description: Record a scripted, narrated browser walkthrough from a project's demo. Add --project <name> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py demo

save.description: Save a project document. Add --project <name> --kind storyboard|edit|demo --text "<yaml>"

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/video_lab.py save

commands.title: Storyboard a launch teaser
commands.prompt: Use the video-lab plugin to storyboard a short launch teaser about {{topic}}: write 4 to 6 shots with beats, visuals and narration, save it as a Video Lab project and build the animatic. Show me the estimate before rendering anything paid.

inputs.label: What is it about?
inputs.placeholder: this release, a feature, a paper

commands.title: Rough-cut a recording
commands.prompt: Use the video-lab plugin to index {{path}}, then make a tightened rough cut in 16:9 and 9:16 with karaoke captions. Tell me how much time was removed.
